fsm_states_hba_global.name: H:Init
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Resets state variables; clears GHC.AE / GHC.IE / IS register to reset values; clears GHC.HR=0 after reset. Entered asynchronously on GHC.HR=1 or power-up.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: H:WaitForAhciEnable
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Waits for GHC.AE=1 before allowing AHCI commands.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: H:Idle
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Normal operation; selects the next sub-state (Ccc / Em / port servicing) based on GHC.AE / CCC_CTL.EN / EM_CTL.RST / EM_CTL.TM / message-received events.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Ccc:Enable
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Initialize Command Completion Coalescing variables hCccTimer = CCC_CTL.TV, hCccComplete = 0.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Ccc:TimerDecrement
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Decrement hCccTimer once per 1 ms while CCC is enabled and commands are outstanding.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Ccc:SetIS
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Clear hCccComplete; reset hCccTimer; set IS.IPS[CCC_CTL.INT]=1.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Ccc:GenIntr
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Generate a system interrupt for CCC.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Em:Reset
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Reset enclosure management logic and the attached enclosure processor; clear EM_CTL.CTL.RST.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Em:MsgRecv
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Receive an EM message into the EM buffer; set EM_CTL.STS.MR=1.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Em:MsgXmit
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Transmit the EM message from the EM buffer; clear EM_CTL.CTL.TM=0.

fsm_states_port.name: P:NotRunning
fsm_states_port.description: PxCMD.ST=0; port DMA engine idle; PxCMD.CR=0.

fsm_states_port.name: P:Idle
fsm_states_port.description: PxCMD.ST=1 + PxCMD.CR=1; no command outstanding; waiting for PxCI / PxSACT to advance.

fsm_states_port.name: P:FetchCmd
fsm_states_port.description: Reads Command Header from system memory at PxCLB[CCS].

fsm_states_port.name: P:FetchCFIS
fsm_states_port.description: Reads Command FIS (CFIS) from the Command Table at CTBA.

fsm_states_port.name: P:CmdTransmit
fsm_states_port.description: Transmits CFIS to the device over the SATA link.

fsm_states_port.name: P:DataXmit
fsm_states_port.description: Streams Data FIS payload from PRDT-described system memory to the device (write).

fsm_states_port.name: P:DataRecv
fsm_states_port.description: Sinks Data FIS payload from the device into PRDT-described system memory (read).

fsm_states_port.name: P:DMASetup
fsm_states_port.description: Processes DMA Setup FIS; updates DSFIS in Received FIS Structure.

fsm_states_port.name: P:PIOSetup
fsm_states_port.description: Processes PIO Setup FIS; updates PSFIS.

fsm_states_port.name: P:D2HRecv
fsm_states_port.description: Processes D2H Register FIS; updates RFIS + PxTFD + (signature) PxSIG.

fsm_states_port.name: P:SDBRecv
fsm_states_port.description: Processes Set Device Bits FIS; updates SDBFIS + PxSACT (clear bits).

fsm_states_port.name: P:Error
fsm_states_port.description: Error handling — sets PxIS / PxSERR; if Fatal, port stops (PxCMD.ST→0 by hardware).

fsm_states_port.name: P:OOB
fsm_states_port.description: PHY performing Out-Of-Band signaling; PxSSTS.DET=01 (Phy not est) or 03 (Phy + device).

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: COMRESET_send
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host PHY sends COMRESET burst (triggered by PxSCTL.DET=1).

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: Await_COMINIT
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host PHY listens for COMINIT response from device.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: Await_COMWAKE
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host PHY listens for COMWAKE response.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: ALIGN_lock
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: PHY achieves bit + word lock via continuous ALIGN primitives.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: Speed_Negotiate
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host tries highest supported speed; falls back until device agrees.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: L0_PhyRdy
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: PhyRdy = 1; Link layer can now exchange FISes; PxSSTS.DET=03.

fsm_transitions_major.description: Port DMA engine begins to service slot.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: Command FIS R_OK received + C bit set
fsm_transitions_major.description: BSY cleared via R_OK; await Data/D2H.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: Set Device Bits FIS with I=1
Task File ERR or unexpected BSY/DRQ

fsm_hints.trigger: Software sets PxCI[slot] (and PxSACT[slot] for NCQ); HBA does the rest.
fsm_hints.rule: Per-port DMA engine + Link/PHY operates in parallel with other ports; there is no cross-port arbitration mandated by AHCI (vendor decides).
fsm_hints.abort: Software clears PxCMD.ST=0 to stop the port (PxCMD.CR follows to 0); for software reset, use the SRST sequence (Command Header R bit + first H2D Register FIS with SRST=1, second with SRST=0, then poll PxSIG and PxTFD).

anti_deadlock_rule: If PxTFD.STS.BSY or PxTFD.STS.DRQ remains stuck without R_OK after a CFIS transmit, software can use the Command List Override (PxCMD.CLO) bit when CAP.SCLO=1 to force BSY/DRQ clear so a software reset can be issued.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On HBA reset: GHC.AE = CAP.SAM (RO 1 when SAM=1, else RW 0), GHC.IE=0, GHC.HR clears to 0 after reset, IS=0, BOHC unaffected. On port reset (PxSCTL.DET=1 → 0): the PHY runs OOB; on PhyRdy + L0 the device sends a D2H Register FIS containing its signature, which the HBA loads into PxSIG and PxTFD.

default_ready_state_recommendation.PxCMD.ST: 0 (Stop) — software sets 1 to start port DMA engine after configuring PxCLB/PxFB.
default_ready_state_recommendation.PxCMD.FRE: 0 (FIS Receive disabled) — software sets 1 BEFORE setting PxCMD.ST=1.
default_ready_state_recommendation.PxCMD.SUD: 0 (Staggered Spin-Up disabled by default if CAP.SSS=1) — software sets 1 to spin up the device.
default_ready_state_recommendation.PxCMD.ICC: 0h (Idle / No-Op) at reset; software writes 1h/2h/6h/8h to request Active/Partial/Slumber/DevSleep.

configurations.name: Direct-attach single port
configurations.description: PxFBS.EN=0; PMP=0 in all CFIS; standard AHCI command flow.

configurations.name: Port Multiplier — Command-Based
configurations.description: CAP.SPM=1, PxFBS.EN=0; software loads PMP into the H2D Register FIS for each command; only one PM port can have an outstanding command at a time.

configurations.name: Port Multiplier — FIS-Based Switching
configurations.description: CAP.FBSS=1, PxFBS.EN=1; HBA tracks per-PMP context (pBsy / pDrq / pIssueSlot arrays of size 16); Received FIS Structure becomes 4 KB.

configurations.name: NCQ enabled
configurations.description: CAP.SNCQ=1; software issues queued commands (READ FPDMA QUEUED 0x60 / WRITE FPDMA QUEUED 0x61) by setting both PxSACT[slot] and PxCI[slot].

timing_dependency_rule: All AHCI register operations are asynchronous to the SATA link — software writes a register, the HBA picks it up on its internal clock domain. The PxCI bit is sampled by the port DMA engine continuously while PxCMD.ST=1. The PHY's OOB envelope detector and the Link layer ALIGN-lock both have their own implementation-defined timeouts; AHCI 1.3.1 inherits all timing from Serial ATA 2.6.
